notes: Entry five: the misdirection broken by the accused.
Section 31 is aboard, and the denial is credible **because they had
every reason to lie and did not bother**: "No. But then I would not be
calling you." That is a better exit from a wrong theory than the
detective spotting her own flaw, and it leaves her with something
worse than a villain -- an absence.
The Prime Directive argument is the one this shelf was always going to
have to hold, and it is deliberately **not resolved**. She refuses to
finish the sentence on the record, which is the only honest thing
title: Personal Log: Entry Five
subtitle: Lt. Lucy Shepard, cultural survey, U.S.S. Adirondack
author: recorded aboard this shuttle

lines.text: PERSONAL LOG: ENTRY FIVE
DAY 149. SEVEN JULY
Ten days since the county died. I am not sleeping much.
This week has been eventful
THE ARRAY
Lt Shepard. We owe you something. The long-range array is gone.
It went with the drive in February. Nothing left to fix.
I asked how long they had known. They had always known.
We did not want you to stop looking for our people.
I have not stopped. I will not stop. Say the rest.
Nobody filed this posting. Nobody expects a report.
No relay inside forty light years. Nobody is coming.
I already knew. Hearing it is a different organ.
THE ARGUMENT UP THERE
So the wardroom is arguing about coming down for good.
A hundred and forty-one people, a valley, no way home.
And somebody said: Prime Directive. They are not wrong.
You do not settle a pre-warp world. That is rule one.
Then somebody said: what culture are we contaminating?
A long pause on the tape. She does not fill it.
My field notes answer that, and I hate all of them.
The rule was written for a living civilisation. This one...
I am not finishing that sentence on a recording.
I said not yet. I am staying down. Ask me in a month.
THEN
Last night somebody called on a channel I did not know.
Lieutenant. You have been using a word on an open log.
I am the reason that word is classified. I am aboard.
I will not put a name in this file. They asked.
It is not ours. I would know. It is not ours.
I asked if they would tell me if it were.
No. But then I would not be calling you.
She says afterwards that she believed them. She sounds tired.
So: a Federation weapon that is not the Federation's.
Five months angry at the wrong people?
I would like the wrong people back.
ENTRY FIVE ENDS
